source: Uploaded benchmark_summary(1).json, event_level_summary.json and metrics_per_holdout(2).csv, examined 2026-11-22; 180 unique method rows; user-uploaded results, not a new assistant-run DDPM inference.

protocol.primary_selection: random by native support only, not hidden energy flux
protocol.temporal_independence: 12 date-separated EDR acquisition clusters; independence of geomagnetic storms not demonstrated

diagnostic_warnings: The mean of sector-level gradient ratios (conditional DDPM 1.335) is inflated by nearly flat true-gradient sectors. The ratio of pooled mean predicted to pooled mean true gradient is approximately 0.145, and should not be conflated with 1.335.
The mean of peak ratios is sensitive to quiet sectors with low true peak; mean absolute peak errors are more comparable (conditional DDPM ~8.08 vs interpolation ~4.11 erg cm^-2 s^-1).
Mean R^2 is unstable, particularly for direct OVATION (~-75.93) because of near-constant target sectors.
Acquisition-level cluster bootstrap covers only time-selected January 2005 cases and does not establish storm independence or multiyear generality.
No confidence interval for systematic prediction in truly unobserved regions is available; all scores are artificially withheld measured SSUSI cells.
No active-sector stress test on the 12 independent acquisitions has yet been returned; that follow-up is required before calling R3-5 closed.
reviewer_response_status: All R2-1/R2-2/R2-3/R3-3/R3-4/R3-5 Responses withheld until final experiments, consistency review, and associated manuscript updates are complete.
